interpretation.title: ▼ Candidate NDVI decrease · Region 01
interpretation.observed_measurement: Mean ΔNDVI -0.245 index units (median -0.229 index units) at the recorded threshold |Δ| ≥ 0.15; 1,230 px = 12.30 ha = 0.74 % of the 165,136-px shared-valid footprint.
interpretation.meaning: A lower NDVI value here means the later composite reads lower in NDVI than the earlier composite. In a mangrove/tidal delta context a NDVI decrease can reflect canopy change, water-level or turbidity differences between the acquisition windows, or tidal state — it is not, by itself, evidence of mangrove destruction.
explanations: Seasonal or tidal water-level differences change the spectral mix of the cell.
Turbidity and sun-glint differences between the composite windows.
Genuine canopy thinning or regrowth — plausible, but it cannot be separated from the options above using optical indices alone.
interpretation.evidence_strength: Shared-valid coverage for this comparison is 100.00 % of the AOI (165,136 px). The region is a connected 1,230-px component at a stated threshold — adjacent pixels are not independent observations, so no significance is claimed. Candidate spectral signal with stated thresholds, not independently verified change.
cannot_conclude: That mangrove was destroyed or restored (no independent labels).
Which fraction of the signal is tidal versus vegetation change.

masking_and_cloud_limitations: Tidal stage and turbidity are uncontrolled confounders.
Mixed mangrove/water pixels at 10 m.
No species or ecological-causation claim.
The following indices use 20 m SWIR bands resampled to the 10 m analysis grid and contain no genuine 10 m SWIR detail: mndwi.
Composites are robust within-period summaries of a few observations, not a dense time series; inter-annual change is represented by two period composites only.

Cloud, shadow and saturated-pixel exclusion relies on the provider SCL product; terrain shadow is not independently re-derived.
Surface reflectance is the provider L2A product; no independent atmospheric correction is performed.
Areas are planimetric on the documented projected grid; UTM scale distortion at this AOI is small but nonzero.

confounding_factors: Seasonal or tidal water-level differences change the spectral mix of the cell.
Turbidity and sun-glint differences between the composite windows.
Genuine canopy thinning or regrowth — plausible, but it cannot be separated from the options above using optical indices alone.

relationships.overlap_rule: equal-area UTM intersection ≥ 10 % of the smaller region

method_provenance.algorithm: threshold candidate mask → 4-connected components (scipy.ndimage.label) → MMU filter → top-K selection
